title: Quadratic completed equation at a rational geometric node
statement: Let $F$ be a field and let $X$ be a scheme locally of finite type over $F$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], of topological Krull dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $z\in X$ be a closed point [def-weil-closed-points] which is $F$-rational, meaning that the structure map $F\to\kappa(z)$ to its residue field [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism. Let $\overline F/F$ be an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $\bar z$ be the $\overline F$-rational point of $X_{\overline F}$ [def-pc-base-change] induced by $z$. Suppose $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X_{\overline F},\bar z}$ is isomorphic as a ring to $\overline F[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Then there are $a,b,c\in F$ with $b^2-4ac\ne0$ and an $F$-algebra isomorphism $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X,z}\cong F[[u,v]]/(au^2+buv+cv^2)$. Completions are maximal-ideal-adic [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and the power series rings are [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series].
